judgment: It is good to hold firm in hardship.
image: Light goes into the earth: Wounded Light.
So the noble one, presiding over the many,
uses darkness, and is still bright.
lines: The wounded light flies, its wings drooping.
The noble one travels three days without food.
and his host has words for him.
Wounded light — wounded in the left thigh.
Rescue with a strong horse: good.
Wounded light, hunting in the south —
He goes into the left side of the belly
and reaches the heart of the wounded light,
then out by gate and courtyard.
It is good to hold firm.
then it went down into the earth.

notes.name_en: 明夷 light wounded (夷 wound, also the eastern Yi); 'Wounded Light'.
notes.L5: 箕子 Jizi, the Shang prince who feigned madness under a tyrant; the name kept, unexplained in verse.
